name: Sting
description:
Your Colony descends upon a creature within short range with stings and bites, dealing 1 damage. Roll Spirit vs Fortitude against the creature. On a win, the creature takes 1 additional damage and -1 Defense.

Describe how you command your Colony.
successes:
✨: On a win, deal an additional 1d4 damage.

🌞: On a win, the creature takes an additional -3 Defense and checks a Condition.
